heroRanked.safe: Desktop upper/middle-left sky, avoiding the bright horizon; mobile upper-left sky. Local dark text backing still needed.
heroRanked.tolerance: No embedded mark; best geometric tolerance. Current ±32px/1.035 scale requires about 48px vertical and 25px horizontal safety at 1440×900. Recheck tree/lamp edges in motion; no live animation tested.
heroRanked.fit: Best current crop compatibility with the rounded hero, but night changes the bright reference mood. Rights and high-DPR detail remain blockers.
heroRanked.limits: 1440px square; desktop crops upper star field and lower ground. Narrow mobile crop shifts right to retain tree/lights and loses left hut context.

heroRanked.safe: Desktop dark left woodland; mobile upper-left woodland below embedded top-center wordmark, with short copy. Keep stream visible.
heroRanked.tolerance: Top wordmark has only roughly 50–60px margin in desktop crop, close to the 48px motion reserve. Static preview is not proof of safe translation; require full-envelope review or clean master.
heroRanked.fit: Strong forest identity and mobile leading line. Wide frame sacrifices lower stream; embedded top wordmark competes with navbar.
heroRanked.limits: 1440×1439 near-square; desktop removes lower stream and some canopy. Mobile retains stream and wordmark but trims side woodland.

heroRanked.safe: Desktop left water below cabin band; mobile upper-middle water, avoiding cabins and bottom-right mark. Bright ripples require dark backing.
heroRanked.tolerance: Bottom-right mark ends about 20px from source edge: less than the ~48px desktop motion reserve. Recommend static presentation until a licensed clean master is obtained.
heroRanked.fit: Daylight water alternative only. The logo-retaining desktop crop clips cabin roofs/setting and removes forest/sky depth; require a clean wider master rather than approving this crop for production.
heroRanked.limits: 1440px square; full-width desktop crop must sit at the bottom to keep the logo. Mobile is right anchored to retain the logo, showing fewer cabins.

heroRanked.safe: Desktop left sky with dark backing, below top wordmark; mobile upper-middle sky. Avoid the central landform.
heroRanked.tolerance: Top wordmark margin is limited and the landform lies close to the desktop bottom. Prefer static until clean wider master/crop-envelope review; do not animate sky and land as separate layers.
heroRanked.fit: Cinematic blue sky/sea, but central subject and top logo constrain the reference composition. Mobile clips outer landform edges.
heroRanked.limits: 1440px square; desktop keeps mark/landform but drops foreground vegetation. Mobile crops landform edges, not the embedded wordmark.

heroRanked.safe: Desktop dark left trees. Mobile copy is shown in the letterbox area; this is a fallback, not a full-bleed crop.
heroRanked.tolerance: Both bottom corner overlays must remain; about 20px bottom reserve is insufficient for current desktop parallax. No narrow crop can retain both corners.
heroRanked.fit: Still the strongest scenic direction from MEDIA-01, but least usable in the existing cover hero without a larger clean master. Mobile full-frame fallback cannot reproduce the current immersive cover layout.
heroRanked.limits: 1440px square; bottom-anchored desktop crop loses sky/hills. 375×812 preview uses contain/letterboxing because a fill crop would remove one or both embedded overlays.
